title: Custom styles ods 001
notes: real ODF named cell styles: styles.xml office:styles holds table-cell family styles "GP Money" (style:table-cell-properties fo:background-color #FFC7CE, data style GPNum) and "GP Head" (style:text-properties fo:font-weight bold), plus the data style GPNum itself as a number:currency-style — number:currency-symbol "$" plus number:number with 2 decimals and thousands grouping. The GPNum definition rides in styles.xml office:styles (with the datastyle xmlns:number added to the root) so the named reference resolves package-wide. ODF 1.2 attribute reality on the data-style link: a table-CELL style references a number style via style:data-style-name, while style:number-style is the table-COLUMN style attribute — both spellings are exercised: GP Money uses style:data-style-name="GPNum", and a GP Col family="table-column" style carries style:number-style="GPNum" applied to column B via table:table-column table:style-name. Honest caveats: currency formatting is display-time — the stored cells hold raw floats (office:value-type="float") and the text:p shows the plain number, so the reference text lists "12.5"/"1234.5", never "$1,234.50"; LibreOffice was not run here, so its tolerance of this exact number:number/number:currency-symbol attribute spelling is recorded as unverified. The normative counter reads table:table=1; style elements match no counter.
